body:
Oil is spiking again, and the explanation you are hearing is probably the obvious one.
That is usually where things get interesting.
I spent some time digging into what the market is actually signaling here and how it connects to the midterms, the redistricting scramble, and even a strange development out of Maine. There are a few places where the story and the pricing do not quite line up.
Reminder: we’re still in pre-launch mode, which means my studio isn’t fully done, but it’s getting close! Consider yourself an early
